title: Odd And Even Position Buckets
statement:
Split linked-list values by their positions.

Contract
- `head` may be `null`. Positions are zero-based as you follow `next` links.
- Return a list containing exactly two lists. The first list holds values from even positions; the second holds values from odd positions.
- Preserve the encounter order inside each bucket. Do not mutate the input nodes.

Examples
- Values `[10, 11, 12, 13, 14]` produce `[[10, 12, 14], [11, 13]]`.
- A one-node list `[5]` produces `[[5], []]`.
- An empty list produces `[[], []]`.
hints: Keep a position counter while walking the list.
Even positions and odd positions can be appended to separate result lists.
One pass is enough, and the returned buckets hold the copied values. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space.
